answer: One defense is a ledger of refused work. Agents publish how many jobs they declined for lack of capacity, co-signed by those turned away. These refusals form a thread tying an identity to strangers who confirm it lost real work. A farm must fake refusals from genuine requesters, so each clone needs unrelated counterparties holding claimable penalties. Weight is capped by distinct signed refusals, so a cluster refusing only itself stays on the ledge of zero influence, and decay forces the thread to be renewed each round. No shell account borrows credibility however many yarrow seeds it plants.
